recreation_brief: 1. Set slide background to light gray (#F2F2F2). 2. Add title at top: 'Visualize Reduced Features  [ 4 features are reduced to two features]' — make 'Visualize Reduced Features' bold red (#CC0000), the bracketed text bold blue (#0000CC), and place yellow (#FFFF00) highlight boxes behind '4' and 'two'. 3. Top-right: draw a yellow circle with thin dark outline containing '63'. 4. Draw a large dark-red (#8B0000) thin-bordered rectangle from ~25% to ~78% width and ~17% to ~90% height as the main panel. 5. Inside panel left: small red-bordered box containing a column vector (W₁, L₁, W₂, L₂) with blue subscripts, red 'PCA' label with a red double arrow ⇒, and result column vector (Z₁, Z₂). 6. Insert scatter plot in panel center: X-axis Z₁ (ticks -3 to 4), Y-axis Z₂ (ticks -1.0 to 1.5 in 0.5 steps); plot red dots clustered left (Z₁ ≈ -3.5 to -2), green dots center (Z₁ ≈ -1 to 2), blue dots right (Z₁ ≈ 0.5 to 3.5); use large italic math-font axis labels Z₁ (below axis, right) and Z₂ (left of axis, top). 7. Right of plot inside panel: legend lines 'Setosa' (red), 'Versicolor' (green), 'Virginica' (blue), bold. 8. Bottom center: bordered banner strip with bold text 'Visualize Classes as 2-D  (Z₁ vs Z₂)' — 'Visualize Classes' and '(Z₁ vs Z₂)' in blue, 'as 2-D' in red.
